tasks.subject: Task 1: hasshape/withshape kernel traits
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/rbf.jl` (after GeneralizedPolyharmonic callable, ~line 190)
- Modify: `src/wendland.jl` (at end)

**Verify:** `mcp__julia__julia_eval`: `import Pkg; Pkg.test("ScatteredInterpolation")` → all pass

**Steps:** TDD per plan Task 1: failing trait tests in test/rbf.jl + test/wendland.jl → traits in src/rbf.jl (default false + Union true + withshape per kernel; Wendland methods in src/wendland.jl since it's included after rbf.jl) → pass → commit.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Rippa LOOCV helpers (src/rippa.jl)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Exact leave-one-out error and score helpers for plain and bordered (saddle) systems, validated against brute-force leave-one-out.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/rippa.jl`
- Modify: `src/ScatteredInterpolation.jl` (include after rbf.jl)
- Create: `test/rippa.jl`
- Modify: `test/runtests.jl` (include between wendland.jl and pum.jl)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `loocverrors(A, w)` matches brute-force LOO on a 12-point Gaussian(4) system, atol 1e-10
- [ ] Same identity for ridge-smoothed A + σI
- [ ] Matrix RHS: one diagonal serves all columns
- [ ] Bordered `loocverrors(M, WΛ, n)` matches brute-force LOO on a GeneralizedMultiquadratic saddle system, atol 1e-10
- [ ] `loocvscore` equals sum(abs2, loocverrors(...)) and returns Inf for singular input instead of throwing
- [ ] Full test suite passes

**Verify:** `mcp__julia__julia_eval`: `import Pkg; Pkg.test("ScatteredInterpolation")` → all pass

**Steps:** TDD per plan Task 2; complete code in the plan document.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Per-patch LOOCV tuning in the PUM build
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `tune = :loocv` selects each patch's ε by scanning 11 scale-derived candidates (LOOCV_CANDIDATES = 2.0 .^ (-2:0.5:3), ε = c/h with h the patch mean nearest-neighbor distance) scored with Rippa's formula, inside the existing threaded local-solve loop.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/pum.jl` (LOOCV_CANDIDATES, meannndist, tuneshape(::RadialBasisFunction, ...), solvelocal; build loop routed through solvelocal)
- Test: `test/pum.jl`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Tuned 3D build (n = 5000, Gaussian(), tune = :loocv) off-node max error < 0.5× untuned Gaussian(2)
- [ ] Exactness at nodes preserved under tuning (dims 2 and 3, atol 1e-6)
- [ ] Matrix samples and smooth = 1e-3 builds work under tuning
- [ ] Two tuned builds bit-identical (weights and per-patch ε)
- [ ] Tiny/degenerate patches don't error (h == 0 → kernel unchanged; np < 3 → ε = c_mid/h without scanning)
- [ ] Full test suite passes

**Verify:** `mcp__julia__julia_eval`: `import Pkg; Pkg.test("ScatteredInterpolation")` → all pass

**Steps:** TDD per plan Task 5; complete code in plan. GeneralizedMultiquadratic dispatch lands in Task 7.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/pum.jl", "test/pum.jl"], "verifyCommand": "mcp__julia__julia_eval: import Pkg; Pkg.test(\"ScatteredInterpolation\")", "acceptanceCriteria": ["tuned beats mis-scaled fixed eps by 2x at n=5000 3D", "exactness at nodes dims 2 and 3", "matrix samples and smoothing work tuned", "deterministic tuned builds", "degenerate patch fallbacks", "full suite passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
